Let us talk later, meet my parents.

познакомиться.gloss: to get acquainted, to meet (for the first time)

meanings.en: to meet for the first time, to get acquainted
meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'знакомиться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to get acquainted, to meet (for the first time)', paired with 'знакомиться'.

examples.text: Надо его обязательно с кем-нибудь познакомить.
examples.trans: We definitely need to introduce him to someone.

examples.text: Придумал, с кем сегодня отца познакомить?
examples.trans: Did you think of who to introduce your father to today?

examples.text: Ты же сама хотела его познакомить.
examples.trans: You wanted to introduce him to someone yourself.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian spatial or relational preposition meaning 'with / from', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Спокойной тебе ночи и сладких снов.
examples.trans: Good night to you and sweet dreams.

examples.text: Сейчас всё выглядит очень некрасиво.
examples.trans: Right now everything looks very bad.

examples.text: Поэтому мы должны всё честно рассказать.
examples.trans: Therefore we must tell everything honestly.

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'parents' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Настя ведь сегодня уехала к родителям.
examples.trans: Nastya went to visit her parents today after all.

examples.text: Давай поговорим потом, познакомься с родителями.
examples.trans: Let us talk later, meet my parents.

examples.text: Пожалуйста, родителям не говорите.
examples.trans: Please don't tell my parents.

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'mom' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Ладно, я уже поговорила с мамой.
examples.trans: Alright, I already talked with my mom.

examples.text: Мама, папа, а это мой Денис.
examples.trans: Mom, Dad, and this is my Denis.

examples.text: Познакомьтесь, это мамина хорошая подруга Евгения.
examples.trans: Meet her, this is Mom's good friend Yevgeniya.

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'dad' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Папа, почему вы сидите в темноте?
examples.trans: Dad, why are you sitting in the dark?

examples.text: Нет, они с папой не сойдутся.
examples.trans: No, she and Dad will not get along.

examples.text: Привет, папа, тебе налить как всегда?
examples.trans: Hello, Dad, should I pour for you as usual?

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'my', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Поехали домой, а мне на работу.
examples.trans: Let us go home, and I have to go to work.

examples.text: Ладно, я уже поговорила с мамой.
examples.trans: Alright, I already talked with my mom.

examples.text: Мама, папа, а это мой Денис.
examples.trans: Mom, Dad, and this is my Denis.
